text:
milo: Heads-up: noticed a few dark-mode visual nits in the latest console build. Ticket below with screenshots. Quick poll: prefer stronger token contrast or more distinct chart markers? :bar_chart:

sam: What specifically is failing for small text?

milo: Inline tokens (model ids, small badges) at 11px lose clarity on secondary panels. Also thin chart lines (1px) blend in if two hues are near-siblings.

ivy: Could we add micro-shadows or a faint backdrop to inline tokens instead of increasing global luminance? Keeps overall mood.

rika: For charts, patterns + markers is the correct path. Also propose reserving saturated accents for "alerts" only.

milo: Prototype idea: 1) .token-inline { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 4px; } 2) chart palette: use colorblind-friendly base + pattern overlay for thin lines.

sam: Agree on minimal backdrop for tokens. But check printing and high-contrast themes.

rika: theme-bot: preview when branch pushed?

theme-bot: Preview ready: https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/preview/inkline-legend-1771 - includes token backdrops, legend markers, and chart pattern toggles.

ivy: I'll run a quick 8-person microtest (identify series + read token). Share results tomorrow.

milo: Thanks team  will open PR with CSS snippet and before/after screenshots. :thumbsup:
